title: Lost update: the payment gateway and the cart-expiry reaper both advance one order
notes: The customer pays. The gateway authorises the payment and writes the order to 'Placed'. 190ms later the cart-expiry reaper read that same row while it was still 'Pending', spent 140ms tidying up the basket session, and then wrote 'Cancelled' -- clobbering an authorisation it had never seen. The customer is charged INR 4,500 and the order they paid for no longer exists. The confirmation step then finds an order in a state it cannot settle and returns HTTP 500. No single trace shows the collision: the reaper is a cron sweep with its own trace id.
assertions: the order a customer successfully paid for must not end up Cancelled
